title: Coherent Optical Detection of Middle Ear Disease
official: Otitis Media Diagnosis and Treatment: Coherent Optical Detection of Middle Ear Disease
summary: The purpose of this project is to see if optical coherence tomography (OCT), a new technology acting as an ultrasound for the ear, facilitates accurately diagnosing acute otitis media (AOM) and otitis media with effusion (OME) in children. Clinical diagnoses made using solely otoscopy will be compared to those made with the addition of OCT.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Parental complaint of ear infection or ear pain (Children's Wisconsin Urgent Care Clinics) OR referred for evaluation of otitis media with effusion (Children's Wisconsin ENT Clinic)
* Speak English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children with craniofacial abnormalities
* Children with diagnosed immunologic abnormalities
* Children with congenital syndromic conditions
* Current open and functioning ear tubes
